what: Scrolling the card grid makes each column follow late by a different share, so the wall staggers — per frame, the scroll movement (px per frame at 60fps) × .25 clamped to ±4rem gives a value V that is followed with .15s exponential decay, and each card is pushed down by its column’s share (.5 · 1 · .25 · .75) × V rem. Scroll down fast and the second column lags the most, and when you stop it realigns in .15s

options.cols: Number of columns — if not set, count them from the grid’s grid-template-columns
options.[data-fx-part=item]: Cards to push (columns are assigned in grid order)

from.where: index.html .pp-lineup__wall · list.html performer wall — original lineUp.lag: columns [.5,1,.25,.75] · gain .25 · most 4 · settle .15

note: Hidden cards (display:none) are skipped when counting order. The translate property is used so it does not collide with the card’s transform (tilt part)
